finding.basis: Domain Quantity calls resources.units/Decimal; m3-v2-approval-workbench promises to review persisted v2 plans and preserve server decimal strings.

finding.suggested_fix: Preserve and display the authenticated server decimal string without Number conversion or imposing a narrower lexical grammar.
